lines: 第001章炼气家族，李青元！
云霞镇，李氏仙族。
说是仙族，其实也不过是个小小的三流炼气家族。
但即便只是三流炼气家族，对于凡人来说依旧是高不可攀、令人敬畏的修仙家族。
“七年半了！”
一座小院门前，一名七岁孩童穿着一件青衫，长发束起，脸蛋秀气可爱，一双眸子炯炯有神。
李青元一张小脸充满期待，满怀期待的同时又充满忐忑。
“今年七岁，终于到了家族一年一度检测灵根的年龄。”
“我会有灵根吗？”
李青元既期待又害怕，担忧道：“如果没有灵根我该怎么办？”
穿越七年半，李青元早已明白自己来到了一个可以修仙的世界，还出身在一个炼气家族。
即便这个炼气家族只是三流炼气家族，但只要他拥有灵根，一定会得到家族培养，直接走上修仙之路。
起点虽然低，但他已经半只脚跨入仙缘。
凡人中，偶尔也有拥有灵根的人，却因为没有仙缘而蹉跎一生，直至老死也无缘修仙。
现在，李青元只差开启仙缘的钥匙——灵根。
“这一世父亲是五灵根，母亲是凡人，我拥有灵根的可能性超越普通凡人。”
李青元深呼吸，说道：“即便只是五灵根，最低等的杂灵根，那也是灵根。”
“只要有灵根，就能修行。”
“呵欠～”
父亲李定舟一脸慵懒，缓缓来到小院，他伸了伸懒腰道：“元儿，今天起这么早呢？”
看到自己儿子那张秀气可爱的小脸浮现期待和忐忑，李定舟洒然一笑，说道：“看到你小子这个表情，为父也想到了自己当年检测灵根时的样子。”
“怎么样，是不是很紧张？”
这时，母亲陈秀云也走出门，拍了丈夫一下，没好气道：“元儿已经够紧张了，你还逗他？”
“有你这样当爹的吗？”
陈秀云说道：“快去吧，今天可是一年一度家族检测灵根的大日子。”
李氏一族每年会为孩子们检测一次灵根，年龄要求七周岁以上。
为何一年一度，因为检测灵根需要使用特殊法器，需要消耗不少灵石维持运转，故而一年一度。
半年前，李青元已经满七岁。
现在七岁半的他，也要检测灵根了。
李定舟点头道：“走吧，元儿。”
李青元快步跟上去，不忘挥手作别道：“娘，我们走了。”
陈秀云目送父子二人离去，双手合十，低声呢喃：“历代先祖在上，保佑我家元儿拥有灵根，顺利成为仙师。”
李氏仙族人口三千，执掌云霞镇方圆三十里，族内拥有灵根的修士常年维持六十人上下。

Chapter 001 Qi Refining Family, Li Qingyuan!
Yunxia Town, Li Clan.
Although it is said to be an immortal clan, it is actually just a small third-rate Qi-refining family.
But even if it is only a third-rate Qi-refining family, it is still an unattainable and awe-inspiring immortal-cultivating family for ordinary people.
"Seven and a half years!"
In front of a small courtyard, a seven-year-old child was wearing a green shirt, with long hair tied up, a delicate and cute face, and a pair of bright eyes.
Li Qingyuan's small face was full of expectation, full of expectation and full of apprehension at the same time.
"I am seven years old this year, and I have finally reached the age where my family's spiritual roots are tested every year."
"Will I have spiritual roots?"
Li Qingyuan was both looking forward to it and afraid, and worried: "What should I do if I don't have spiritual roots?"
After traveling through seven and a half years, Li Qingyuan had already understood that he had come to a world where he could cultivate immortality, and he was born in a Qi-refining family.
Even if this Qi Refining Family is only a third-rate Qi Refining Family, as long as he has spiritual roots, he will definitely be trained by the family and directly embark on the path of cultivating immortality.
Although the starting point is low, he has already stepped half into the world of immortality.
Among mortals, there are occasionally people with spiritual roots, but they waste their lives because they have no chance to become immortals, and they have no chance to cultivate immortality until they die.
Now, Li Qingyuan only needs the key to unlock the immortal destiny-spiritual root.
"In this life, my father has five spiritual roots and my mother is a mortal. The possibility of me possessing spiritual roots is beyond ordinary mortals."
Li Qingyuan took a deep breath and said: "Even if it is just the five spiritual roots, the lowest mixed spiritual roots, they are still spiritual roots."
"As long as you have spiritual roots, you can practice."
"Yawn~"
Father Li Dingzhou looked lazy and slowly came to the small courtyard. He stretched his waist and said, "Yuan'er, why did you get up so early today?"
Seeing the anticipation and anxiety on his son's cute little face, Li Dingzhou smiled casually and said, "Seeing your boy's expression, my father also thought of the way he looked when he was testing his spiritual roots."
"How are you? Are you nervous?"
Li Qingyuan: "..."
At this time, her mother Chen Xiuyun also walked out of the door, patted her husband, and said angrily: "Yuan'er is already nervous enough, and you still tease him?"
"Are there any fathers like you?"
Chen Xiuyun said: "Go quickly, today is a big day for the family to test their spiritual roots."
The Li family will test the spiritual roots of their children once a year, and the age requirement is seven years or older.
Why is it once a year? Because detecting spiritual roots requires the use of special instruments and consumes a lot of spiritual stones to maintain operation, it is only once a year.
Six months ago, Li Qingyuan turned seven.
Now that he is seven and a half years old, he also needs to have his spiritual roots tested.
Li Dingzhou nodded and said, "Let's go, Yuan'er."
Li Qingyuan quickly followed, not forgetting to wave goodbye and say: "Mother, we are leaving."
Chen Xiuyun watched the father and son leave, clasped his hands together, and murmured in a low voice: "The ancestors of all generations, please bless my Yuan'er to have spiritual roots and successfully become an immortal master."
The Li Immortal Clan has a population of 3,000 and controls an area of 30 miles around Yunxia Town. There are about 60 monks with spiritual roots in the clan all year round.
